sections.text:
In the peaceful sky of London, where children sleep and dream, there was a family called the Darlings who lived in a warm and beautiful house.

The eldest daughter, Wendy, loved telling fairy tales and adventures to her two younger brothers, John and Michael, every night before bed.

The hero of most of her stories was a magical boy called Peter Pan, a boy who refuses to grow up and lives on a magical island called Neverland.

The children did not know that Peter Pan was a real character, and that he would come at night to sit at their window to listen to Wendy's stories!
One night, as Peter was listening, his shadow ran away from him, and while trying to catch him, Wendy woke up and saw him with her own eyes.

Wendy helped Peter return his shadow, and Peter thanked her, admired her courage and kindness, and asked her to come with him to Never Never Island to be a mother to the Lost Boys and tell them stories.

Wendy hesitated at first, but Peter used Tinker Bell's fairy dust and sprinkled it on Wendy and her two brothers.

As soon as the children thought happy thoughts, they started floating in the air! They flew with Peter Pan from the window of their room, heading towards the starry sky.

Peter said: “The road is the second star on the right, then they fly straight until the morning!”

After an enchanting journey, they arrive at Never Never Island, an island full of bright colors, mermaids, Native Americans, and wild animals.

The Lost Boys welcomed Wendy with great joy, and built a small house for her out of branches and leaves for her to live in and read stories to them.

But the island was not only a place for games, it was full of dangers, the most dangerous of which were sea pirates led by the evil Captain Hook.

Hook hated Peter Pan very much and sought revenge on him, because in a previous battle, Peter cut off his hand and threw it to a huge crocodile.

Since then, the crocodile has been chasing Hook to eat the rest of his body, and because the crocodile swallowed an alarm clock, Hook would hear the sound of “tick tock” whenever the crocodile approached, and he would run away in terror!
One day, Captain Hook kidnapped Wendy, her two brothers, and the Lost Boys to force them to work as pirates, and took them to his ship.

Peter Pan learned what happened, so he flew angrily to the ship to save his friends.

An intense and exciting sword battle between Peter Pan and Captain Hook begins on the deck of the ship, while the boys bravely fight off the pirates.

Thanks to Peter's agility and flying skill, he overpowers Hook and pushes him towards the edge of the ship.

At that moment, a tick-tock sound was heard coming from the sea, where the hungry crocodile was waiting!
Captain Hook fell into the water, ran away with the crocodile chasing him, and was never seen again after that day.

Peter and the children took control of the pirate ship, and Tinker Bell sprinkled her magic dust on the entire ship and it began to fly through the air.

Despite the happiness and adventures they had, Wendy began to feel longing for her parents and her warm home, and decided to return.

Peter Pan sadly said goodbye to his friends, and flew the ship until he returned Wendy, John, and Michael to the window of their room in London.
